description: Verify that DUT-emitted UDP datagrams with no payload carry Length == 8 (header only) (RFC 768 'Fields' MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The minimum legal UDP Length is 8 — the header alone, with zero payload. Some buggy stacks set Length = 0 in this case (which would be illegal per RFC 768). This case asks DUT to emit a zero-payload UDP and asserts Length is exactly 8.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpTriggerSendUdp request (udpUserDataSize = 0)

2. Observation:
   • DUT → Tester: UDP datagram
     - Length field == 8   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted UDP carries Length = 8.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_length — DUT emitted a zero-payload UDP whose Length is not 8 (e.g. 0)
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any UDP within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted zero-payload UDP carries Length = 8 — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_length: DUT emitted zero-payload UDP with Length not 8
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT-originated UDP within the listen window
